reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text:
I’m giving it one star because it looks great and works if you leave your phone with this app on the screen exclusively and stare at it using your mind powers. 

But if you set it to countdown for several hours and then say, I don’t know, go use your phone or live your life or set your phone down to DO SOMETHING ELSE BESIDES STARE AT THE SCREEN then let me tell you my friends : this app will not provide accurate time keeping. And that can lead to heartbreak. Ask me how I know. 

It’s pretty. And it works for short timing if you dedicate your entire phone to it.
